statuses.partial: Concrete arities, ranks, extents or single-result cases fit; the entire schema needs operand-list/graph-list or result adaptation.
statuses.nonlocal: The rewrite needs a separately existing graph value outside the matched subtree; graph lookup or nonlocal matching support is not currently provided.
